name: USB Speed Adjustable Milk Frother
description:
Product Type-USB Rechargeable  Milk Frothers
Color-Multicolor
ADJUSTABLE 3 SPEEDS: The milk frother have 3 speeds for optional, included low, medium and high speed. Easy to get creamy froth quickly. The rechargeable milk Frother's runs very powerful and effectively, has a great performance in mixing.
DOUBLE WHISKS: The rechargeable milk frother comes with 2 different whisks,easy and free to switch.Double whisks electric milk frother can be good helperin different situations such as liquid 2.foods,milkshakes,cocktails,eggs,soups etc.
LOW DECIBEL OPERATION: Differ to other electric egg beater in the market,ours can work with low noise.So you can freely cook at home,and the noise will not affect your family,just enjoy your happy cooking moment and delicious food.
USB RECHARGEABLE: Electric mixer hand held with eco-friendly 1200mAh rechargeable lithium battery via USB cable. Don’t need to purchase AA+ batteries frequently for coffee frother, don’t hurt your wallet frequently for your milk frother.
